heading: Your first transaction
subtitle: Connect a real wallet and write one line into a contract the whole class shares. Test network, zero real money.

steps.label: Wallet
steps.title: Get a wallet
actions: Install Rabby or Zerion on your phone (or MetaMask), then create an account.
Write the secret recovery phrase on paper. Never type it into a website, this one included.
Use a fresh wallet for this course, not one that holds real funds.
steps.why: a [wallet](kw:wallet) is a key pair, not an account at a company. The address is public; the key is what signs.

steps.label: Test ETH
steps.title: Get test ETH on Sepolia
actions: Copy your wallet address. It starts with 0x.
Paste it into a faucet. Start with pk910: no login, it mines test ETH in your browser tab.
Wait until the balance shows in your wallet. The smallest payout is far more than you need.
steps.why: every [transaction](kw:transaction) pays a fee, called [gas](kw:gas), even on a test network. Test ETH pays it and has no real value.

steps.label: Connect
steps.title: Connect and switch to Sepolia
actions: Press Connect wallet and pick your wallet. Phone wallet? Scan the QR code, or open this page in the wallet's built-in browser.
Approve the connection in the wallet. It shares your public address, nothing else.
If the wallet is on another network, press Switch to Sepolia.
steps.why: connecting lets this page see your address. It cannot move anything: every action still needs your signature.

steps.label: Register
steps.title: Send your transaction
actions: Look at the hash under the field: it is the only thing that leaves your browser.
Press Send and confirm in your wallet. You sign, and you pay gas.
steps.why: you are changing the contract's [state](kw:state). What you write is public and permanent: that is [immutability](kw:immutability), first hand.

steps.label: On-chain
steps.title: See it on-chain
actions: Open the transaction on Etherscan: your address, the contract, the gas you paid.
The class count went up by one. Every node now stores your entry.
Keep the transaction hash. It is your receipt.
steps.why: nobody approved this, and nobody can undo it. The same five steps, with real ETH, are how mainnet works.

wallets.heading: Pick one
wallets.rabby: Clear previews of what each signature will do.
wallets.zerion: Simple phone wallet with a built-in browser.
wallets.safety: The recovery phrase IS the wallet. Whoever has the words controls the funds.

faucets.heading: Sepolia faucets
faucets.pk910: Solve a captcha, leave the tab mining, then claim. Start early: reaching the minimum payout takes a while.
faucets.google: Sign in with a Google account, paste your address and request test ETH.
faucets.alchemy: Only pays wallets that already hold 0.001 real ETH on Ethereum mainnet.
faucets.note: A faucet is a website that gives away small amounts of test ETH. Nothing here costs money.

web3.loadError: The wallet tools could not load. Check your connection and reload the page.
web3.wrongNetwork: Your wallet is on another network (chain ID {{id}}).
web3.switchHint: Not in your wallet's list? This button adds it for you.
web3.noFunds: No test ETH yet. Without it you cannot pay gas.
web3.ready: Ready. Go to the next step.
web3.noWalletConnect: QR-code connection is not switched on yet. On a phone, open this page in your wallet's built-in browser.
web3.needConnect: Connect your wallet on Sepolia first.
web3.contractPending: The class contract is not live yet. Your instructor will switch it on. Everything up to this step already works.
web3.emptyPreview: Type your number to see its hash.
web3.privacy: Public and permanent. Only the hash is sent, but anyone who already knows your student number can compute the same hash and recognise your entry.
web3.privacyRaw: Public and permanent. This text is stored exactly as typed, for everyone to read, forever.
web3.tooLong: Too long: the contract accepts at most {{max}} characters.
web3.alreadyRegistered: This wallet is already registered. Sending again replaces your entry; the count stays the same, and the contract records that you registered again.
web3.mining: Sent. Waiting for the network to include it…
web3.reverted: The network included the transaction, but the contract rejected it.

errors.rejected: You declined the request in your wallet. Nothing was sent.
errors.noFunds: Not enough test ETH to pay gas. Get more from a faucet.

web3.noTxYet: No transaction yet. Send one in step 4 and the result appears here.
web3.registeredEarlier: This wallet is already on the class list
web3.matches: Matches the hash of the number you typed.
web3.readBack: Read back from the contract, not from this page.

board.legend: Newest first. ×2 or more: that wallet registered again and replaced its hash.
board.notDeployed: The class contract is not deployed yet. Once it is live, every registered wallet and its hash are listed here.
board.loading: Reading the list from the contract…
board.error: The contract could not be read. Check your connection, then press Refresh.
board.empty: Nobody has registered yet. Send your transaction in the wizard, then press Refresh.
board.lookupHint: Hashed here in your browser, exactly as in the wizard, then compared with the list.
board.emptyHash: Type a student number to see its hash.
board.lookupNotDeployed: The class contract is not deployed yet, so there is no list to check against. The value above is what the wizard will send.
board.foundOne: This hash is on the list. It was registered by this wallet:
board.foundMany: This hash is on the list. {{n}} wallets registered it:
board.notFoundBody: No wallet on the list holds this hash. Check the number for typos. Just sent the transaction? Press Refresh.
board.free: Reading is free: no wallet, no signature, no gas. The number you type never leaves your browser.
